item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas bskang bshags ye shes kun khyab
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ skong bshags ye shes kun khyab zhes bya ba/ thugs dam rgyud nas bskang ba'i las kha/ sgrub pa'i 'phrin las don gyi zur byang / chags nyams bskang zhing bshags pa'i cha rkyen/ yum sras gshen gsum gyi lung don/ stag la me 'bar gyi thugs dam/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs bcud/ stang chen dmu tsha'i dngos grub 'di/ kun dga' tshul khrims bdag la brgyud/ zhig mchog bla mas bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris/ nyes 'gal mchis na bzod gsol bzhes/ dge bas 'gro la phan thog shog/
